div.div: دَامُوغٌ One that wounds so as to reach the دِمَاغٌ [or brain]; and that breaks the head or the like. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) And حَجَرٌ دَامُوغَةٌ A stone that does so much, or vehemently: the ة denoting intensiveness of signification. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
